en.headline: Development Bureau orders review of Queen Mary Hospital lift works
en.dek: ArchSD and EMSD must report on how they accepted and supervised the new Clinical Block lifts; follow-up repairs are due by the end of the year.
body: The Development Bureau said on Friday it was highly concerned that newly installed lifts at the new Clinical Block of Queen Mary Hospital had failed to function effectively. It has asked the Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department to submit reports reviewing their acceptance and supervision of the project.

A bureau spokesman said the departments had been responsible for supervising the contractor. After learning that progress was unsatisfactory, the bureau had for several months pressed them to finish rectification work, including checks on electronic devices, connections, shaft conditions and workmanship, to find why the lifts were unstable. Follow-up work is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of this year.

The spokesman said it was now an appropriate time to review whether the two departments’ supervision of this project could be improved and whether the oversight system for similar jobs should be tightened. The bureau aims to finish that review and set out next steps within October.

The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has said a registered lift engineer on the works was convicted of improperly issuing safety certificates and submitting false or misleading documents, and is awaiting sentence. It also said a registered lift contractor faces separate legal proceedings over a fatal industrial accident at the site last year.

zh.headline: 發展局要求兩署檢視瑪麗醫院新大樓升降機監管
zh.dek: 建築署及機電署須就驗收及監管工作提交報告；善後工程料於今年第四季完成。
body: 發展局星期五表示，高度關注瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓新裝升降機未能有效運作，已要求建築署及機電工程署提交報告，全面檢視兩個部門在項目中的驗收及監管工作。
發言人指，醫院工程一直由有關部門監督承建商。局方早前得悉進度未如理想，過去數月督促部門盡快完成執修，包括檢查電子儀器、接駁位、井道狀況及裝配工藝，查找升降機運作不穩的原因。各項善後工作預計可於今年第四季完成。
發言人說，現時是合適時機檢視建築署及機電署在此項目的監管有否可改善之處，以及同類工程的監督制度是否有優化空間。發展局擬於10月內完成審視並提出後續安排。
機電工程署表示，涉事註冊升降機工程師因不當地發出安全證書及提交虛假或具誤導性文件已被定罪，正等候判刑。署方又指，註冊升降機承建商另因去年在地盤發生的致命工業意外，正進入司法程序。
